front.transcription:
EVENT
ENCODED MESSAGES
Choose 2 players. They select 1 card from their hands and swap them.
Play any time. Not an action.

EVENT
WEEKEND RENDEZVOUS
You may move any pawn(s) to a single city containing another pawn.
Play any time. Not an action.

EVENT
SCRAMBLE TEAMS
Move every team up to 3 cities away from their current locations.
Play any time. Not an action.

STOP
Draw this card just before you set up your first game in February.

back.transcription:
MISSION BRIEFING
"Okay team, listen up. First off, we got a couple of Soviet scientists nosin' around our home soil, and we gotta figure out what they're doin'.
Second thing: I'm told the current strain of the MEDUSA plague is non-lethal, but the Reds ain't gonna leave it at that. They're starting up trials, experimentin' on local populations in three different cities. We want you to stop it, all of it, but I got a word of advice:
Things can get...real complicated out in the field. Sometimes you can't do everything for everyone. It shakes loose that way...just... just keep in mind savin' one city is better than savin' none, y'know?"

front.transcription:
RIGHT NOW
Open the following doors:
L 35
Add the Disrupt Trial action to each reference sheet.

This is your first disrupt trial objective.
To set it up, separate the 6 Africa City cards from the Player deck, shuffle them, and place 3 of them faceup into the Operations area. These are the 3 trial cities.
Then, shuffle the remaining Africa cards back into the Player deck.
Finally, put this card on top of the trial City cards and flip it over.

back.transcription:
FEBRUARY OBJECTIVE 1
DISRUPT THE FIRST TRIAL
Disrupt Trial in:
1, 2, OR 3 KNOWN CITIES IN AFRICA AT THE SAME TIME
Completed: Read Debrief 174
Failed: Read Debrief 169

front.transcription:
This objective has an unknown target city.
To set it up, separate the 8 North America City cards from the Player deck, shuffle them, and place 1 of them facedown into the Operations area.
Then, shuffle the remaining North America cards back into the Player deck without looking at them.
Finally, flip this card over and place it on top of the unknown City card.

back.transcription:
FEBRUARY OBJECTIVE 2
INVESTIGATE SOVIET SCIENTISTS
Acquire Target in:
1 UNKNOWN CITY IN NORTH AMERICA
Completed: Read Debrief 191
Failed: Read Debrief 149

front.transcription:
PAUSE
Draw this card and read the back when instructed (when you complete or fail the Disrupt Trial objective).

back.transcription:
RIGHT NOW
1 Draw the next 3 cards in this deck.
2 Turn each city where the trial was NOT disrupted into an Exposed city (following the rules for Marking Exposed Cities). These cities are now exposed to MEDUSA, and Disease cubes will appear on them when Infection cards are drawn for them.
3 Destroy any unused Infection cards.
4 Move the 3 City cards under the Disrupt Trial objective to the Player discard pile.

front.transcription:
PAUSE
Draw this card and read the back during step 3 at the end of the first game in February.
